The premise of this game is excellent.  Push back the Creepers with your weapons; meanwhile Energy is everything - without it nothing will get built in time.  It's like Tower Defense with a timer on it. And I LOVE TD games.

Here's the problem:
[b]Once you get to level 13, it's no longer any fun AT ALL.[/b]  I've played for 26 hours, and literally 20 of them were spent on this level, which I've played 35+ times, and even with YouTube I am unable to crack it.

It's looking like "Developer Nerd Rage".  (Dude is like... "I will make this so that there is only ONE solution!")

At this stage, it's all about fast-twitch response.  Basically an arcade video game (Donkey Kong, Ms. Pac-Man, etc), where the difficulty grows exponentially, and you have to put in hours and hours to get good at it.  It's no longer a TD game.  It's Frustration-squared.

If that's okay with you - playing the same level for days with no success, and you like challenges like that, this is 100% for you.  

The price is right, but for me, the gameplay isn't.

Cheers!

However, this game has not had that effect. I'm nearly done with doing all the achievements, and every mission still feels quite fun and fresh. Each mission is more of a puzzle to solve, and you cannot always just brute force your way to victory. Though I will say, some missions in the story felt a little bit unfair, especially with some random ♥♥♥♥♥ the game just threw at you, which you'd have no way to prepare for unless you looked up a guide beforehand. That being said, I did enjoy this game way more than the first one. The sidescrolling view works pretty well, and the new tools are quite fun. Creeper Worldシリーズでもこの２は評価が悪かったので、遊んでいなかったのですが、実際に遊んでみて
何故悪評なのかが分かりました。

最初の１０面は普通にＣＷしていますが、１３面からギミックによる強制ゲームオーバーが入り始めます。
○○分以内にどこかを破壊しなければゲームオーバー、という内容が続き出します。

ＣＷ１の出来が良かったので、その後続として方向性を見誤り、ＣＷ３で元に戻したという感じです。
１３面以降１９面までこの殺しセットが続き、１９面は実質上の最終面という事で５箇所ぐらいを最速で順序よく
破壊していく必要があり、もはやＣＷではなくただのパズルで、ギブアップしました。
２０面に至っては元々あるＣＷの武器を使わない、という別ゲーと化しており、ゲーム性を自己否定しています。

ＣＷは序盤の猛攻に耐えて乗り切り、そこから巻き返していくのが面白いゲームだと思います。
一手一手最速でどのユニットをどこに作るか、をパズルしていくのは最凶難易度のＴＤにありがちですが、
そのような要素は自分は求めていないので、お勧めししません。

残念ながら最新策のＩＸＥも同じ様なパズル要素になってしまっており、ＣＷ２の再来になっている様です。
どうも横から見た画面というのは、ＣＷシリーズとは相性が悪いみたいです。
言わば横画面で縦シューティングを作っている様なものであり、根本的に難しいのでしょう。


メインストーリーもパズル化しており、ボーナスステージはさらにパズル化がひどいので、お金を出しても
ストレスしか得られないと思います。

This installment into the Creeper World series brings a literal change in perspective. The original top-down tower defense switches to a side-view.

The general gist of fighting off an endlessly oncoming liquid remains the same, however in this adventure, you will be digging through a narrow segment of the game world in order to get to the root of the threat.

The change is certainly interesting and refreshes the gameplay quite a bit. Mainly in the sense where it's difficult to tell by sight how much Creeper is located in an area. A single square can hold massive amounts of Creeper. Once you unleash them, well... Best hope you're prepared because that one square might devour you!

Not everyone might like this type of gameplay but as the second installment, it's certainly a test to see something different from the creator and it's definitely great to see that a small developer explores options. The third installment falls back to the first game and improves upon it. But I do think this game is a breath of fresh air.

Gameplay: Imagine taking the concepts of Creeper World 1, making it subterranean and instead of having the area around your ship gather energy it provides the light that powers the buildings around it. Upgrades have been changed from something you collect on the map to a resource you can divert energy to create (or find.) YOU CAN TURN OFF THE AIR RAID SIREN... THANK THE HEAVENS SOMEONE WAS SMART! Story: You play a commander who has a dispute with the alliance about the truth being given to a panel. The admiral keeps you busy sending you to planets while they fend off invading forces at home. You have to jump around the galaxy (without a map because tiled story missions are in and a galaxy map is out :(  ) and save the universe. After over a decade of attempting to beat this game, hitting extreme difficulty spike walls, and quitting for years at a time, I finally beat the game 100%! This is effectively the Zelda 2 of the series for a ton of reasons. Creeper World 1 is top down perspective, has a gentle difficulty slope, and feels fair to play, just like Zelda 1. It's a zen difficult game where even the trickiest levels can feel calming to slowly conquer. Creeper World 2 on the other hand is a side view perspective, has multiple Extreme difficulty spikes, and can feel very unfair until you figure out the exact approach to take to beat the level after multiple attempts. It also adds a bunch of new building types, enemy types, anti-creeper, and gravity. Yes, it's literally raining creeper, and it's raining hard. Now to 100% Creeper World 3 (another top down title, so it's this series' Zelda 3: A Link to the Past) and 4 (a 3D version) before IXE (another side view game like CW2, but way better based on the previews) comes out...

《爬行者世界3》似乎有很多評論和人氣，但前兩部感覺被忽視了。 在三部《爬行者世界3》中，顯然是一部傑作，故事也最有趣，但前兩部仍然製作精良，提供了很多背景資訊，尤其是這部電影有著不同的（側視）視角，這讓它很有趣，因為向下的重力往往起著作用。
對於那些沒有玩過本系列遊戲的人來說，這是一款塔防遊戲，你可以移動塔樓，並與從某些點發射的單個敵人（一種巨大的黏液）作戰。 你的目標是摧毀足够的黏液，以達到這些點，並摧毀這些黏液生成點。 通常感覺就像你也在“爬行”你的塔樓向前。
讓這些遊戲如此有趣的不僅僅是有趣的遊戲玩法（儘管做得很好），還有故事。 作為“不朽防禦”的開發者，我對有故事的塔防遊戲有一些瞭解，如果你喜歡我的遊戲，我想說這個系列（尤其是第三個）幾乎肯定值得一試。
這些遊戲的唯一缺點是它們在其他地方都是免費的——Steam版本有一些小的更新，比如新的配樂，但當你可以在Kongregate等其他網站上免費玩時，這些變化是否值得5美元由你决定。 至少，這意味著你可以先玩免費的線上版本來决定是否喜歡它。另一個輕微的負面影響是，在前兩款遊戲（包括《爬行者世界2》）中，GUI/使用者介面感覺非常匆忙，而且往往設計得很差。 但我沒有讓這妨礙我享受比賽。
